subject: Peregrine Analytics demo planning & pause notice
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@peregrineanalytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro demo & agenda — Peregrine Analytics

Hi Ari,

Great to connect earlier. Thanks for the quick qualification call — as promised, attaching a short agenda for a 45-minute technical + product demo where we can:

- Walk a configured inference pipeline for a small batch of queries
- Show latency / cost tradeoffs and quantization options
- Discuss deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC) and pilot milestones

Proposed times next week (PST):
- Tue 2/23 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2/24 13:00–13:45
- Thu 2/25 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, let me know a couple slots and we’ll adapt. Agenda attached: Demo-Agenda-v2.pdf (slide + runbook).

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: Demo-Agenda-v2.pdf

From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@peregrineanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@peregrineanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo & agenda — Peregrine Analytics

Hi Sergio — thanks for the agenda and options. Really appreciate the clear plan.

Unfortunately two things popped up on our side:
1) Our engineering org is in the middle of a re-org that surfaced this week — leadership asked us to pause new pilots until priorities for H2 are confirmed.
2) I will be traveling for product roadshows next week, and Priya (who would own the pilot) is out with family leave the week after that.

Given that, we need to park the demo for now. I don’t want to ghost you — we’re still interested in inference capabilities but need to re-evaluate timing. Can we put this on hold and check back in the first week of May? If you have a short recorded walkthrough we can review internally in the meantime, that would help.

Appreciate your flexibility — apologies for the short notice.

Best,
Ari Kaplan
Director of Product | Peregrine Analytics
ari.kaplan@peregrineanalytics.com
(212) 555-0890

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: sergio@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo & agenda — internal

Sergio/Monica — quick thought:

If Ari’s team is deprioritizing and folks are out, let’s offer two low-effort options:
1) A 20–25 minute recorded demo tailored to their use case we can send to Ari + Priya for asynchronous review (no calendar required).
2) A nurture plan with a short checklist and a Q2 check-in scheduled for early May (we can offer a pilot credit and reserve a Dedicated slot for Q3 if they want).

If Ari wants to pause entirely, we should still add them to the prospect waitlist + tag the HS record as "pilot-paused — org re-org" so SDRs don’t over-engage.

I can draft the email with the recording and the checklist; Sergio, can you confirm the credit amount we’re willing to promise (e.g., $10k pilot credit) or should CS/RevOps weigh in?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@peregrineanalytics.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Intro demo & agenda — Peregrine Analytics

Hi Ari — thanks for the heads up and totally understandable given the re-org and travel.

We can absolutely pause. A couple quick offers while you regroup:
- I’ll send a short, 18-minute recorded walkthrough focused on the inference cost/latency tradeoffs for batch vs streaming.
- Attached is a lightweight Pilot-Checklist.xlsx that outlines required roles, data access needs, and a rough 8-week timeline if you decide to run a pilot later this year.
- We can tentatively reserve a Dedicated pilot slot for Q3; no commitment required — just to make ramping easier if you choose to proceed.

If May works better for a live re-eval, I’ll put a tentative reminder in our tracker to ping you on 2027-05-02.

Thanks — and safe travels.

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Pilot-Checklist.xlsx

From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@peregrineanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo & agenda — Peregrine Analytics

Sergio / Monica —

Following up to confirm we’ll park the demo for now. We’ll re-evaluate during our Q2 planning; please reach out in early June to reconfirm timing.

One ask from procurement: when we re-engage, can you include a simple one-page pilot SOW (scope, duration, data handling) and a rough ballpark for a 3-month pilot? That will help speed approvals internally.

Thanks again for being flexible. Remove the current calendar hold and we’ll look to reconnect in June.

Regards,
Ari Kaplan
Director of Product | Peregrine Analytics
ari.kaplan@peregrineanalytics.com
